title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Typical Cases of Crimes Endangering Food Safety
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Release of Typical Cases of Crimes Endangering Food Safety

Case 1:

Wang Changbing et al. — Production and Sale of Toxic Food, Production and Sale of Counterfeit and Substandard Products Case

— Case of Producing and Selling "Fake Liquor"

(1) Brief Facts

In 2002, Defendant Wang Changbing began blending edible alcohol with tap water, corn liquor, sodium cyclamate, and other raw materials to produce liquor, which he sold as corn liquor for profit. On the morning of March 15, 2009, Wang Changbing instructed his employees Qin Changjiang and Tang Yongfeng to drive to Yidu City to purchase alcohol from "Boss Yang" (Yang Dalian). At approximately 17:00 on the same day, Qin Changjiang and Tang Yongfeng arrived at the Yidu Juneng Daily Chemical Business Department operated by Yang Yongbing and purchased 3.74 tons of industrial alcohol (methanol) at a price of RMB 2,100 per ton, transporting the alcohol back to Wang Changbing's liquor brewing workshop that evening. Upon reviewing the weighbridge tickets and other documents, Wang Changbing discovered that the purchased alcohol was priced as industrial alcohol, significantly different from the price of edible alcohol, but he did not verify the reason. That evening, Wang Changbing instructed Defendant Tang Qian to use the purchased industrial alcohol to blend with tap water, corn liquor, flavoring, and other raw materials to produce over 6,000 kilograms of "liquor." From the next day to the 25th of the same month, Wang Changbing and Defendant Qin Changfen sold a total of 3,448 kilograms of this batch of "liquor." Many local residents who consumed the "liquor" were poisoned, resulting in the serious consequences of 5 deaths, 6 serious injuries, 11 minor injuries, and 2 slight injuries. It was also found that since 2004, Wang Changbing had produced "liquor" blended with edible alcohol and sold it as corn liquor, totaling over RMB 1.85 million; Qin Changfen participated in the production and sale totaling over RMB 1.86 million; Tang Qian participated in the production and sale totaling over RMB 1.79 million.

(2) Judgment

The Yichang Intermediate People's Court of Hubei Province held in the first-instance judgment, and the Hubei High People's Court affirmed in the second-instance ruling, that Wang Changbing concurrently operated a business in industrial alcohol fuel and a business in blending liquor, and was fully aware of the market prices of industrial alcohol and edible alcohol. When he knew that the alcohol purchased by his employees at half the price of edible alcohol could not possibly be edible alcohol, he neither carefully questioned the employees nor verified with the seller, and continued to use the purchased industrial alcohol to blend and produce "liquor" for sale, leading to the serious harm of multiple casualties. His conduct constituted the crime of producing and selling toxic food. Wang Changbing, Qin Changfen, and Tang Qian used tap water, edible alcohol, and a small amount of self-brewed corn liquor to blend "liquor" and sold it as corn liquor, constituting the crime of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products. In the joint crime of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products, Wang Changbing was the principal offender; Qin Changfen and Tang Qian were both accessories and could be given a mitigated punishment according to law; Tang Qian was under 18 years old when committing part of the criminal acts, which could be considered as a discretionary circumstance for a lighter punishment. Wang Changbing acted with indirect intent, truthfully confessed his criminal facts after arrest, and actively compensated the victims for economic losses, which could be considered as discretionary sentencing circumstances. Accordingly, the court lawfully rendered the following judgment: Defendant Wang Changbing was convicted of the crime of producing and selling toxic food and sentenced to death, with a two-year reprieve, deprivation of political rights for life, and a fine of RMB 10,000; convicted of the crime of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products and sentenced to 12 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 980,000; for concurrent punishment for multiple crimes, the sentence was executed as death, with a two-year reprieve, deprivation of political rights for life, and a fine of RMB 990,000. Qin Changfen was convicted of the crime of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products and sentenced to 3 years' imprisonment, suspended for 5 years, and a fine of RMB 990,000. Tang Qian was convicted of the crime of producing counterfeit and substandard products and sentenced to 2 years' imprisonment, suspended for 2 years, and a fine of RMB 960,000.

Case 2:

Chen Jinshun et al. — Production and Sale of Counterfeit and Substandard Products, Illegal Business Operation, Production and Sale of Food Not Meeting Safety Standards Case

— Case of Illegally Operating "Sick and Dead Pig" Meat

(1) Brief Facts

From November 2010, Defendant Chen Kaimei went to Putian to purchase sick and dead pigs, and hired Defendant Zhang Ke at a monthly salary of RMB 2,000 to transport the sick and dead pigs to a pig farm rented by Defendant Chen Jinshun. There, Defendant Lin Binxia slaughtered them and sold them to Defendant Chen Jinshun, with total sales exceeding RMB 300,000 and illegal gains of RMB 120,000.

Chen Jinshun purchased and resold the meat of sick and dead pigs, with sales exceeding RMB 500,000 and illegal gains of RMB 200,000. During this period, he hired Defendants Li You and Chen Zhihui at a monthly salary of RMB 2,000 to RMB 2,500 to escort vehicles, collect payments, and transport goods. Defendants Zhou Yong and Wu Hong, a married couple, purchased meat of sick and dead pigs from Chen Jinshun to make sausages and other products for sale, with sales exceeding RMB 70,000 and illegal gains of over RMB 15,000. Defendant Zhou Jiancheng purchased over RMB 30,000 worth of meat of sick and dead pigs from Chen Jinshun for resale. Defendant Sun Zhaoran purchased pork ribs from sick and dead pigs from Chen Jinshun for resale, with sales exceeding RMB 7,000 and illegal gains of RMB 1,000. On July 25, 2011, police seized 4,060 jin of unsold meat of sick and dead pigs at the pig farm rented by Chen Jinshun. Upon inspection, the samples were found to contain porcine reproductive and respiratory syndrome virus and porcine circovirus type 2, and the "volatile basic nitrogen" level exceeded the standard.

It was also found that Defendant Chen Jinshun had previously been convicted of the crime of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products and the crime of receiving stolen goods, and was sentenced on April 30, 2008, to 11 months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 82,000, and was released upon completion of his sentence on May 11, 2008.

(2) Judgment

The Xianyou County People's Court of Fujian Province held that Defendant Chen Jinshun purchased meat of sick and dead pigs at low prices for resale; Defendants Chen Kaimei and Lin Binxia purchased sick and dead pigs from others, slaughtered them, and sold the meat; Defendants Li You, Chen Zhihui, and Zhang Ke, knowing that Chen Jinshun and Chen Kaimei were producing and selling meat of sick and dead pigs prohibited by the state, still provided transportation and other assistance. The conduct of each defendant constituted the crimes of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products, producing and selling food not meeting safety standards, and illegal business operation, and each defendant should be punished according to the most serious crime among them. Defendants Zhou Jiancheng and Sun Zhaoran, knowing it was meat of sick and dead pigs, still purchased, processed, and sold it or directly sold it, constituting the crime of producing and selling food not meeting safety standards. Chen Jinshun, Chen Kaimei, and Lin Binxia were principal offenders; Li You, Chen Zhihui, and Zhang Ke were accessories and should be given a lighter or mitigated punishment. Chen Jinshun was a recidivist and should be given a heavier punishment. Accordingly, the court lawfully rendered the following judgment: Defendant Chen Jinshun was convicted of the crime of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products and sentenced to 12 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 1,000,000; Defendant Chen Kaimei was convicted of the crime of illegal business operation and sentenced to 10 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 300,000; Defendant Lin Binxia was convicted of the crime of illegal business operation and sentenced to 9 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 260,000; the remaining defendants were respectively sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment ranging from 4 years to 1 year and fines for the crimes of illegal business operation, producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products, or producing and selling food not meeting safety standards. The judgment has become legally effective.

Case 3:

Fan Guang — Illegal Business Operation Case

— Case of Illegally Selling "Lean Meat Powder" (Clenbuterol)

(1) Brief Facts

Since 2009, Defendant Fan Guang, for the purpose of making exorbitant profits, repeatedly purchased clenbuterol hydrochloride raw powder (commonly known as "lean meat powder") from Ni Luyun (separately prosecuted) of Huainan City, Anhui Province, and in Liangshan County, Shandong Province, mixed the "lean meat powder" raw powder with stone powder in a certain proportion, processed it into bagged feed additives for meat animals, and sold it. After multiple layers of resale, the above items were sold to cattle and sheep breeders, causing a large number of meat cattle and sheep fed with "lean meat powder" to flow into markets across regions. By September 2011, Defendant Fan Guang had purchased a total of 25 kilograms of "lean meat powder" raw powder, mixed it, and sold it, with sales amounting to over RMB 2,000,000.

(2) Judgment

The Lijin County People's Court of Shandong Province held that Defendant Fan Guang, knowing that clenbuterol hydrochloride is a drug prohibited for use in feed, for the purpose of making exorbitant profits, prepared feed additives with clenbuterol hydrochloride and sold them to breeders. His conduct constituted the crime of illegal business operation, and the circumstances were particularly serious, warranting severe punishment according to law. Considering that he truthfully confessed his criminal facts after arrest, he could be given a lighter punishment. Accordingly, the court lawfully rendered the following judgment: Defendant Fan Guang was convicted of the crime of illegal business operation and sentenced to 10 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 300,000. The judgment has become legally effective.

Case 4:

Li Ruixia — Production and Sale of Counterfeit and Substandard Products Case

— Case of Producing and Selling Counterfeit and Substandard Food Additives

(1) Brief Facts

Defendant Li Ruixia was the legal representative of the defendant unit Shanghai Mengkai Chemical Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as "Mengkai Company"), and Defendants Ma Wenge and Ma Minxue were employees of the company. For the purpose of obtaining illegal gains, from September 2010, Mengkai Company purchased at a low price 258.33 tons of floor-grade sodium bicarbonate produced by Tongbai Boyuan New Chemical Co., Ltd. of Henan Province, 40 tons of sodium bicarbonate from Inner Mongolia Xuyue Group Co., Ltd., and production equipment, and also customized 5,000 woven bags labeled as food additive sodium bicarbonate. The two types of sodium bicarbonate were mixed in an 8:1 ratio, dried, pulverized, packaged, and sold to Hangzhou, Quzhou, and other places. A total of 243 tons of counterfeit and substandard sodium bicarbonate were sold, with sales amounting to RMB 447,300. On May 24, 2011, law enforcement officers seized 3.35 tons of finished products, 27.7 tons of raw materials, and production equipment at the production site. Upon inspection, the seized finished food additive sodium bicarbonate was found to be substandard products.

(2) Judgment

The Jinshan District People's Court of Shanghai held that the defendant unit Shanghai Mengkai Chemical Co., Ltd., in the course of business, substituted substandard products for qualified food additive sodium bicarbonate in production and sale, with total sales of RMB 447,300. Its conduct constituted the crime of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products. Defendant Li Ruixia, as the directly responsible supervisor of the defendant unit, and Defendants Ma Wenge and Ma Minxue, as the directly responsible personnel of the defendant unit, their conduct all constituted the crime of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products. Defendants Ma Wenge and Ma Minxue voluntarily surrendered after the crime and truthfully confessed their crimes, constituting voluntary surrender, and could be given a lighter punishment according to law. Defendant Li Ruixia truthfully confessed her crimes after arrest and could be given a lighter punishment according to law. The court lawfully rendered the following judgment: The defendant unit Shanghai Mengkai Chemical Co., Ltd. was convicted of the crime of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products and fined RMB 500,000; Defendant Li Ruixia was convicted of the crime of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products and sentenced to 6 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 150,000; Defendant Ma Wenge was convicted of the crime of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products and sentenced to 4 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 100,000; Defendant Ma Minxue was convicted of the crime of producing and selling counterfeit and substandard products and sentenced to 3 years' imprisonment, suspended for 3 years, and a fine of RMB 100,000; the seized tools used in the crime were confiscated. The judgment has become legally effective.

Case 5:

Yuan Yi, Cheng Jiangping — Sale of Toxic and Harmful Food, Sale of Counterfeit and Substandard Products Case

— Case of Selling "Gutter Oil"

(1) Brief Facts

From July 2009 to July 2011, Defendant Cheng Jiangping, knowing that the oils produced by Jinan Bohui Biotechnology Co., Ltd. and Jinan Green Bioenergy Co., Ltd., operated by Liu Liguo (separately prosecuted), were processed from kitchen waste oil, nevertheless recommended them to Defendant Yuan Yi, the owner of Hongda Grain and Oil Market in the Qingfeng Grain and Oil Market of Zhengzhou City, Henan Province, who operated a business selling edible oil. Cheng Jiangping repeatedly acted as an intermediary for transactions between Yuan Yi and Liu Liguo, earning commissions. Yuan Yi, knowing the above circumstances, purchased large quantities of the illegally processed oils from the two companies through Cheng Jiangping's introduction, paying a total of over RMB 3,000,000 for the oils. Yuan Yi bottled oils worth over RMB 2.95 million and sold them retail to nearby construction site canteens, night stalls, and fried dough stick vendors, or resold them at a markup to edible oil distribution companies in Xinxiang City, Sanmenxia City, and other places. The remaining oils worth RMB 50,000 were sold to Wuzhi County Zhihui Chemical Co., Ltd.

(2) Judgment

The Ningbo Intermediate People's Court of Zhejiang Province held that Defendant Cheng Jiangping, knowing that the oils were processed from kitchen waste oil, nevertheless recommended them to Defendant Yuan Yi and acted as an intermediary to profit from the transactions; Yuan Yi, knowing that the oils recommended by Cheng Jiangping were processed from kitchen waste oil, nevertheless purchased large quantities and sold them as edible oil to food service operators, edible oil distribution companies, etc. The sales amount of the two defendants reached over RMB 2.95 million, and their conduct constituted the crime of selling toxic and harmful food. The two defendants also passed off counterfeit and substandard finished oil as genuine and high-quality, selling it to chemical companies, with a sales amount of RMB 50,000, and their conduct further constituted the crime of selling counterfeit and substandard products. The two defendants committed multiple crimes and should be subject to concurrent punishment according to law. In the joint crime, Yuan Yi was the principal offender; Cheng Jiangping was an accessory and should be given a mitigated punishment according to law. Yuan Yi and Cheng Jiangping showed recognition of their crimes and could be given a lighter punishment. The court lawfully rendered the following judgment: Defendant Yuan Yi was convicted of the crime of selling toxic and harmful food and sentenced to 15 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 400,000; convicted of the crime of selling counterfeit and substandard products and sentenced to 6 months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 30,000; the sentence was executed as 15 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 430,000. Defendant Cheng Jiangping was convicted of the crime of selling toxic and harmful food and sentenced to 8 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 200,000; convicted of the crime of selling counterfeit and substandard products and sentenced to 6 months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 30,000; the sentence was executed as 8 years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 230,000; the criminal gains were ordered to be recovered. The judgment has become legally effective.
